group_invite_links_rotated_fields_match.name: group_invite_links_rotated_fields_match
group_invite_links_rotated_fields_match.value: ("group_invite_links"."status" = 'active' and "group_invite_links"."rotated_at" is null) or ("group_invite_links"."status" = 'rotated' and "group_invite_links"."rotated_at" is not null)

admin_access_requests_decision_fields_ma.name: admin_access_requests_decision_fields_match_status
admin_access_requests_decision_fields_ma.value: ("admin_access_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "admin_access_requests"."decided_at" is null and "admin_access_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is null) or ("admin_access_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "admin_access_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "admin_access_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null)

invitations_acceptance_fields_match.name: invitations_acceptance_fields_match
invitations_acceptance_fields_match.value: ("invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is null) or ("invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is not null)

food_selections_source_fields_match.name: food_selections_source_fields_match
food_selections_source_fields_match.value: ("food_selections"."source" = 'saved_favorite' and "food_selections"."favorite_id" is not null and "food_selections"."resolved_by_user_id" is null) or ("food_selections"."source" = 'manager_resolution' and "food_selections"."resolved_by_user_id" is not null) or ("food_selections"."source" in ('inline', 'declined') and "food_selections"."favorite_id" is null and "food_selections"."resolved_by_user_id" is null)

orders_selected_restaurant_snapshot_comp.name: orders_selected_restaurant_snapshot_complete
orders_selected_restaurant_snapshot_comp.value: ("orders"."selected_restaurant_id" is null and "orders"."selected_branch_id" is null and "orders"."selected_restaurant_name_snapshot" is null and "orders"."selected_branch_name_snapshot" is null) or ("orders"."selected_restaurant_id" is not null and "orders"."selected_branch_id" is not null and "orders"."selected_restaurant_name_snapshot" is not null and "orders"."selected_branch_name_snapshot" is not null)

orders_completion_matches_terminal_state.name: orders_completion_matches_terminal_state
orders_completion_matches_terminal_state.value: ("orders"."state" in ('ordered', 'cancelled') and "orders"."completed_at" is not null) or ("orders"."state" not in ('ordered', 'cancelled') and "orders"."completed_at" is null)
